bestowals.vote_detail: Styled “First winner of GBA Platinum Sports Bra Award” on his own roster card; RUSH's own newsdesk of 26 October 2002 announces the first bi-yearly Golden Boob Awards for its six-month anniversary show, and the card's “GBA” is read as that ceremony.
bestowals.source: Joe Bananas's own roster card, whose Fed Awards line reads “First winner of GBA Platinum Sports Bra Award” (/promotions/rush-2002/archive/joe-bananas-pcw-bio.html); RUSH's own news of 26 October 2002 (/promotions/rush-2002/news/golden-boob-awards-to-air-on-six-month-anniversary-show-hot-2002-10-26.html); the anniversary show's own script, in which the award is presented to him as the most improved wrestler of the semester (/promotions/rush-2002/archive/rush-2002-six-month-anniversary-show-the-first-bi-yearly-golden-boob-awards-2002-11-01.html)

bestowals.vote_detail: Runner-up for Best Heel of the Semester (August to October) at the Golden Boob Awards, by his own card; the winner is not named in what is served.
